issues.description: Class name mismatch in the UML diagram vs. the rest of the exercise: the PlantUML block in the problem statement declares the class as 'Course' (lines 63-74 of problem_statement.md), while the exercise text, the template, and the solution use the class name 'Lecture'. This could confuse students about which class to implement (they may name their class Course following the UML, causing compilation/test failures because the template/tests expect Lecture).
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the UML class in the PlantUML block to 'Lecture' so it matches the exercise description, template, and solution. Concretely, update problem_statement.md lines 63-74: change 'class Course {' to 'class Lecture {' and keep the listed attributes/methods unchanged. This preserves the UML content while removing the naming inconsistency that could mislead students.
